Sweet & Sour Tofu
By: AmandaP
Published: Thursday, October 14, 2010 - 5:48am

Ingredients




4 tablespoons olive oil, divided
3 cloves garlic
7 ounces tofu
1 med. onion, diced
1 cucumber, sliced
1 red pepper, strips
1 can of pineapple (i used chunks)
2 med. tomatoes
1 teaspoon granulated sugars
2 tablespoons thai chili sauce
1 teaspoon soy sauce
1/4 cup water

Preparation

1 Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a wok or large nonstick skillet over med-high heat. 2 Stir in garlic and heat 1 minute or until fragrant. 3 Stir in tofu and cook, stirring occasionally, about 10 minutes, until golden brown; remove tofu from skillet and set aside. 4 Add onion to wok and cook adding oil if needed, stirring occasionally, until tender. 5 Stir in cucumbers, red peppers, and pineapple; cook, stirring, 5 mins. 6 Add tomatoes, sugar, chili sauce, and soy sauce, cover, reduce heat to medium, and cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender. 7 Stir in water and tofu, heat a few minutes more. Serve over rice.

About


This is a great recipe for people looking for a Meatless Monday dinner.  It's quick and easy and the tastes are so flavorful people won't even notice the lack of meat!
For those looking for a good chili sauce try Sriracha, which is the one with the green lid and a large rooster.  This stuff is HOT so add slowly and taste often to avoid any surprises!
